gate-pin.dir.description: Directory, under gate.slot_dir, of the pinned tool worktrees: <gate.slot_dir>/<gate-pin.dir>/<clone id>/<base sha> (one per base sha and clone, shared under a lock; D-A5 as amended by plan §3.3).

gate-pin.enabled.description: GX-05 (B-09, GA-PG1, D-070): a --pr/--sha gate runs the tooling of the base tip (a tool worktree of the base sha) and the invoking checkout is only the record root. Off is the rollback: the invoking checkout's own tooling judges, as before GX-05.

gate-pin.keep_worktrees.description: Base-sha tool worktrees kept per clone on this machine; older ones (least recently used) are removed, never one a running gate holds.

gate-pin.report_only_on_gate_change.description: When the diff base...head touches the gate (commit_check.GATE_FILE), the head's own tooling also runs with --report-only (no events, record, status or pr.ready) and its verdict is printed and posted as advisory. Off skips that second run.
